title: FYIcons categories

categories.description: Keyword rules and category definitions in sidebar order.

id.description: Unique category ID. All and Uncategorized are automatic.

name.description: Display name used throughout the library.

icon.description: Catalog icon shown next to this category.

keywords.description: Match ANY keyword against complete, consecutive name segments, ignoring case. Optional exactNames also match whole names.

items.description: For example, file matches file-add, not profile; arrow-up matches circle-arrow-up-fill. Spaces and underscores also separate segments. New keywords are allowed.

exactNames.description: Optional whole-name matches, in addition to keywords. For example, box matches only Box, not BoundingBox or TextBox. Case and separators are normalized.
